title: Revisions, traffic splitting and gradual rollout

videos.script: Deploying to Cloud Run never changes what is running. It adds something next to it. This lesson is about using that. {{revisions}} Every deployment creates a revision. A revision is the image and its settings, frozen. Nothing ever edits it, so yesterday's code is always there to go back to. {{split}} The address points at a traffic split. Ninety per cent here, ten per cent there, chosen request by request. {{tags}} A tag gives one revision an address of its own. So you can test it before any user reaches it. {{rollout}} Then a gradual rollout. A small share, a number you watch, and a rule written in advance for when to stop. And a rollback that is one command, because nothing has to be built again.
